Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host the "Scaling Inference" developer webinar. Quick proposal for the invite flow so we can lock content and assets this week: 

1) Micro-journey segmentation: three RSVP paths (NA engineers, EU architects, APAC platform leads). Each path gets a slightly different subject line and 2 reminder touchpoints.
2) RSVP mapping: single RSVP form with timezone-aware slot selection (we'll surface local session times + calendar links).
3) Link fingerprinting & tracking: we’ll append per-path UTM and a short link fingerprint id so we can stitch clicks to HubSpot activities.
4) Assets + deadlines: sponsor logos and 300x250 creative by Fri 22 Aug. Speaker deck (draft) by Mon 25 Aug.

Attachments: redwood_microjourney_flow_v1.pdf (flow + UTM matrix).

Asks: can you confirm APAC friendly time windows (prefer 07:00–10:00 PST == evening APAC) and whether FinApps wants co-branding on the reminder emails? Also confirm the external contact for event ops (who we push calendar invites from).

If that sounds good I’ll update the HubSpot campaign and share tracking templates.

Thanks,
Priyom
